description: Generate the index (Register) from the entries of add_index_entry into a new text frame on page_id – at position_mm or exactly at bounds_mm; autoflow true lets InDesign add frames and pages until it fits (pages_added). replace true updates the existing index in its frame. Options (InDesign keeps them in the document for the next run): title ("" for none), title_style, format nested (default) | run_in, include_section_headings (letters A–Z), include_empty_sections, include_hidden_layers, level_styles[] (paragraph styles for levels 1–4), section_heading_style, page_number_style, cross_reference_style, cross_reference_topic_style, separators {following_topic, between_entries, page_range, between_page_numbers, before_cross_reference, entry_end} (metacharacters allowed, e.g. "^=" en dash). Without level styles InDesign creates its own index paragraph styles (localized names). Returns story_id, frame_id, frame_ids, page_id, page_name, page_ids, page_names, bounds_mm (of the first frame, relative to its page), paragraph_count, length, overset, replaced and lines[] {text, paragraph_style} (first 500 paragraphs; lines_truncated). Plus pages_added. Text placed with place_text_file brings no index from Word – build it with add_index_entry.

autoflow.description: Add frames and pages until the index fits (default false).

bounds_mm.description: Exact position and size in mm on page_id, set after InDesign created the frame (overrides position_mm).

x.description: Left edge in mm; negative allowed for bleed (Anschnitt).

y.description: Top edge in mm; negative allowed.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

format.description: Sub-topics on own lines (nested) or run in.

include_overset.description: Also read text in overset (Übersatz). Default false.

layer_name.description: Layer (Ebene) for the new frame, exact name from list_layers. Default: the active layer.

page_id.description: Document page that gets the new frame (from list_pages). Required unless replace.

position_mm.description: Top left corner of the new frame on page_id; InDesign chooses width and height. Default: top left margin corner.

x.description: Left edge in mm from the page.

y.description: Top edge in mm from the page.

replace.description: Update the existing one in its frame instead of creating another (default false). Without an existing one a new one is created (warning).

section_heading_style.description: Paragraph style for the letter headings.

entry_end.description: At the end of each entry.

name: generate_index
title: Generate or update the index
